name: Tool window
desc: Find files: a search, a folder, a filter, and results that fill the window. The gear folds the options away (a state); double-click a result to open it.

windows.script:
; Everything under the folder whose name has the words in it, of the kind
; picked -- the first 500, so a whole drive does not stop the window.
Find() {
    global g, query, folderBox, kindSeg, subSw, results
    results.Delete()
    kinds := Map("docs", "txt,md,doc,docx,pdf,rtf,odt", "pics", "png,jpg,jpeg,gif,bmp,webp,ico",
                 "code", "ahk,js,py,ps1,json,ini,css,html")
    want := kinds.Has(kindSeg.Value) ? "," kinds[kindSeg.Value] "," : ""
    q := Trim(query.Text), n := 0
    g.Status("msg", "Looking...")
    loop files folderBox.Text "\*.*", subSw.Checked ? "FR" : "F" {
        if (q != "" && !InStr(A_LoopFileName, q))
            continue
        if (want != "" && !InStr(want, "," StrLower(A_LoopFileExt) ","))
            continue
        results.Add("", A_LoopFileName, A_LoopFileDir, Format("{:.1f} KB", A_LoopFileSize / 1024),
                    FormatTime(A_LoopFileTimeModified, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"))
        if (++n >= 500)
            break
    }
    results.ModifyCol()                 ; every column fitted to what it holds
    g.Status("msg", n ? "Double-click one to open it" : "Nothing matched")
    g.Status("count", n (n >= 500 ? "+" : "") " found")
}
